contracts.goal: Add or tune an affix without adding new gameplay authority code.
steps: Add or tune the stable affix definition in EquipmentAffixConfig.
Extend contracts/resolver only when the existing schema cannot express the required behavior.
Add focused resolver coverage for any new compatibility, bound, or determinism rule.
Do not add persistence/combat mutation here; those remain with their canonical owners.
escalate_when: a new effect semantic is required
persistence or durable inventory shape must change

contracts.goal: Create a stat/tuning enemy variant primarily through validated configuration.
steps: Express health, movement, reward, and presentation differences in existing config first.
Reuse existing enemy combat/AI semantics when the variant does not need a genuinely new behavior.
Add focused config/resolver coverage for new invariants.
Escalate to an authority change only for a new reusable attack or AI semantic.
escalate_when: a new attack semantic is required
a new AI state/lifecycle is required
reward authority or mission lifecycle must change

contracts.goal: Add a combat feedback/audio/readability variant without creating a new presentation owner.
steps: Reuse the current presentation owner and event contract.
Prefer profile/config changes over another controller or remote.
Add a source audit or fixture when a new mapping/invariant is introduced.
escalate_when: a genuinely new presentation lifecycle owner is required
a new replicated fact must be introduced

contracts.goal: Grow archetypes by reusing class/stat/effect owners instead of parallel progression services.
steps: Add archetype identity/stat choices to ClassConfig and the existing class resolver surface.
Reuse existing effect/reward/progression boundaries before introducing a new service.
Add regression coverage for unlock/application rules.
After the repeated shape stabilizes, move later archetypes toward config-only authoring.
escalate_when: new durable progression state is required
a second progression authority would otherwise be introduced

contracts.goal: Add Main World interactions through the canonical registry/interaction owner rather than script-per-object behavior.
steps: Give the interaction a stable ID and register it with the existing owner.
Keep world objects declarative where possible and avoid one Script per prop/NPC.
Add validation for duplicate IDs/orphan references when the registry expands.
escalate_when: a new interaction transport or owner is required
